text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in what we write. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can read texts in different languages. Another common example is sentiment analysis, where computers decide if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. This is useful for companies checking customer opinions. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with users in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily communication with technology is becoming easier and more helpful.
